title: Vacuum Metric3 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vacuum:metric3
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for vacuum metric3 (3) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate vacuum metric3 (3) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It scores how your vacuum metric3 (3) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
